shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && cat /workspace/package.json && ls /workspace/app 2>/dev/null || find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -name "*.tsx" -o -maxdepth 2 -name "*.ts" | grep -v node_modules | head -30
for f in /workspace/app/layout.tsx /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/app/news/page.tsx /workspace/app/preview/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

git add next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git commit -m "Migrate to Cache Components

- Replace experimental.dynamicIO with cacheComponents: true
- news: replace revalidate = 3600 with 'use cache' + cacheLife('hours')
  (same hourly refresh policy)
- preview: drop force-dynamic; read cookies in a Suspense-wrapped
  component so the draft stays request-specific while the shell
  prerenders

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -2 && git status --short
